features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.desc: You can use Wild Shape as a Bonus Action; in Beast form, you can expend a spell slot to heal 1d8 per level of the slot.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.desc: You transform into Beasts of CR up to 1 (increasing to your Druid level ÷ 3). Your AC in Beast form is at least 13 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.desc: Your attacks in Beast form count as magical; you can add your Wisdom modifier to their damage.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.desc: By expending 2 uses of Wild Shape, you transform into an elemental (see forms).

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.desc: You can cast Alter Self at will (at no cost).
